_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Missing or wrong items
categories.description: Items missing, wrong order delivered, order never arrived.

categories.name: Late deliveries
categories.description: Orders much later than promised, stuck orders.

categories.name: Cold, spilled or bad food
categories.description: Cold or spilled food, stale, wrong quantity, food safety.

categories.name: Delivery fees, platform fees & markups
categories.description: Delivery, platform, packaging and small-order fees; menu prices above the restaurant.
keywords: delivery (fee|charge)|platform fee|service fee|surge|packaging charge|small order fee|markup|price (higher|difference)|expensive

categories.name: Refunds refused
categories.description: Refunds denied or only partial for bad orders.

categories.name: Order cancellations
categories.description: Orders cancelled by restaurant or app, cancellation charges.

categories.name: Memberships, coupons & offers
categories.description: Paid memberships not delivering value, coupons that don't apply.
keywords: zomato gold|swiggy one|dashpass|uber one|deliveroo plus|subscription|membership|coupon|promo code|\boffer\b

categories.name: Rider behaviour
categories.description: Delivery partners being rude, asking for tips or cash, not finding the address.

categories.name: Support & chatbots
categories.description: Chatbots that loop, no human agent, complaints ignored.

categories.name: Account bans & fraud flags
categories.description: Accounts blocked for too many refund requests.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Restaurant owner
personas.description: Lists a restaurant on the apps.

personas.name: Delivery rider
keywords: i('m| am) a (rider|dasher|delivery)|as a (rider|dasher|courier)|delivery partner earnings
